findings: Copy + immediate index shift (likely): in ispf_table_editor/line_commands.rs, immediate I/D entries are collected against original indices but applied after copy/move inserts have already grown the list, so a batch mixing C/A with a D on a later row would delete the wrong row. Not covered by any test. Apply immediates before copy inserts, re-resolve indices, or document+test that mixing copy with immediate in one batch is unsupported. Non-blocking for APPROVED.

enabled_letters omits SORT (possible, cosmetic): LineCommandSet::enabled_letters returns only I/D/C/M and never reflects the sort flag, so a header hint built from it would under-report. Only used for a hint/notice today; confirm no surface relies on it to advertise SORT.
